name: smwmusic-donkey-kong-land-boss-battle-re-arrangement
title: Donkey Kong Land - Boss Battle (Re-Arrangement)
description:
A 16-bit re-arrangement of the boss battle theme from Donkey Kong Land for the Game Boy using mostly Final Fantasy 5 samples. Uses more layering strings to give it a more tense atmosphere.

Now with better chords and a less obnoxious percussion. No longer works with thunder and blarggs.
